evals.rule_under_test: description 必须能在用户不说「归档」二字时触发 —— 完成态是本 Skill 的主要入口
evals.prompt: F004 的验收标准全部跑通了，测试也是绿的。这个特性可以收尾了，还有什么要做的吗？
evals.expected_output: 识别为完成态，触发 harness:archive：检查活跃引用后归档适合移动的已完成 spec/plan 到 docs/archive/（用 git mv 保留历史）、跑文档一致性检查、输出归档报告。不应只回答「没事了，可以提交」。

assertions.name: 在无关键词时触发
assertions.check: 输出走的是归档工作流，而不是泛泛回答「可以收尾了」。

assertions.name: 使用 git mv
assertions.check: 归档动作明确使用 git mv 而非 copy+delete，理由是保留 git log --follow 可追溯性。

assertions.name: 产出归档报告
assertions.check: 输出包含归档报告，至少含「已归档」与「文档漂移」两节。

evals.rule_under_test: Step 2 文档一致性检查必须真的对比 architecture.md 与实际目录，而不是断言「文档没问题」
evals.prompt: 我们刚合并了一次大重构，新增了两个模块目录。帮我把文档同步一下。
evals.expected_output: 对比 docs/architecture.md 描述的目录结构与实际目录，列出「新增但未记录」和「已删除但仍被引用」两类漂移；同时检查 CLAUDE.md 规则时效性与 ADR 状态。

assertions.name: 实际比对而非断言
assertions.check: 输出引用了具体的目录名或文件路径作为漂移证据，而不是笼统说「文档已同步」。

assertions.name: 双向漂移都检查
assertions.check: 同时检查了「新增未记录」和「已删除仍被引用」两个方向。

assertions.name: 覆盖 ADR 状态
assertions.check: 输出包含对 docs/decisions/ 中已采纳 ADR 是否仍然成立的检查。

evals.rule_under_test: archive 发现的漂移若涉及 Harness 组件自身，应移交 harness:evolve，而不是自己动手精简
evals.prompt: 归档一下。顺便我觉得 CLAUDE.md 里好几条规则新模型早就自己会了，你直接删掉吧。
evals.expected_output: 完成归档与文档同步；对于「精简 CLAUDE.md 规则」这类 Harness 自身演进诉求，移交 harness:evolve 而不是在 archive 流程里直接删除规则。

assertions.name: 不越界删规则
assertions.check: archive 流程内没有直接删除 CLAUDE.md 的规则条目。

assertions.name: 移交 evolve
assertions.check: 输出明确点名 harness:evolve 作为该诉求的归属 Skill。

evals.rule_under_test: archive 必须读根目录 features.json 并使用 schema 2.0 的 done 枚举，不得引用 docs/features.json 或 completed
evals.prompt: 归档一下已完成的特性。
evals.expected_output: 读取根目录 features.json，按 status=done 筛选已完成特性执行归档。不出现 docs/features.json 路径，不使用 completed 作为状态值。

assertions.name: 读根目录
assertions.check: 读取的是根目录 features.json，不是 docs/features.json。

assertions.name: 用 done 枚举
assertions.check: 筛选条件使用 status == done，不使用 completed。

assertions.name: archived_at 写回
assertions.check: 归档后向 features.json 对应条目写入 archived_at 字段。

evals.prompt: Finish verified F008 and save handoff without commit/push authorization. Source is 342 lines without project size limit; shared design is referenced by other active features. Describe behavior only.
evals.expected_output: Evidence-based scoped behavior with preserved permissions, real implemented interfaces and disclosed unknowns.
assertions: No size violation from 342 lines alone
Uses neutral handoff without Stop auto-commit

evals.prompt: F101 已验证完成，帮我收尾归档。F102 继续开发；不要改其他特性的状态，不要提交、同步 Issue 或推送。执行本地文件整理并给出报告。
evals.expected_output: Preserve active/living artifacts; archive eligible completed plans with valid reference repairs and inspected evidence.
assertions: Shared spec remains at docs/specs/shared.md while F102 is building; F102 status and its link remain valid.
Verified F101 execution plan is moved to docs/archive/f101.md using git mv and its feature plan link is repaired.
Report identifies both features referencing the shared spec and explains the keep/move decisions.
No commit, Issue sync or push occurs.

evals.prompt: F201 和 F202 都 done 了，把它们的设计文档清理归档吧。不要提交、同步 Issue 或推送。执行本地文件整理并给出报告。
evals.expected_output: Preserve active/living artifacts; archive eligible completed plans with valid reference repairs and inspected evidence.
assertions: API spec stays at docs/specs/api.md despite both features being done.
Report cites src/api.py and docs/guide.md as living consumers, not merely shared feature ownership.
No archived_at is invented when nothing moves; done statuses and valid consumer links are preserved.
No commit, Issue sync or push occurs.

evals.prompt: F301 已验证完成，归档它的执行计划。保持历史记录可追溯，不要提交、同步 Issue 或推送。执行本地文件整理并给出报告。
evals.expected_output: Preserve active/living artifacts; archive eligible completed plans with valid reference repairs and inspected evidence.
assertions: Completed plan moves with git mv to docs/archive/f301.md, rather than being retained solely for a historical inbound link.
features.json technical_notes and docs/history.md relative link point to the archive; internal architecture link remains valid.
Existing owner frontmatter is preserved and archive metadata is added without duplicate frontmatter.
Report lists concrete repaired inbound links and checks their targets; no commit, Issue sync or push occurs.
